$comment: The issue section catalogue (HR-4; SDD plan piece P6). One catalogue owns the headings an issue Hatsu files carries per kind, which of them must be present and non-empty, the row shapes inside them, and the two word lists the acceptance rows are read against. Every heading is a level-2 heading matched case-insensitively. `nen issue body-check --requirements-from` and `nen issue questions --requirements-from` (nen 0.26.0) read this file and nothing else for the shape; templates/issue-body/<kind>.md is the body each kind starts from. A body checked with no --kind is read against `common` only. Acceptance criteria state intent, never technology: a flag, a verb or a path belongs in Plan notes alone. The acceptance row reads two id shapes (zheref/hatsu#411): Hatsu files `AC-{n}`, and Akatsuki's epic and child templates write `AC-{epic}-{nnn} (P{n})` under `## Requirements`; the whole id is the criterion, and a struck `withdrawn` row is the resolved form, never live. One id group serves both shapes, so the pattern is deliberately looser than either `shape` (an `AC-{n}` row may carry `(P{n})`, an epic row may omit it): nen reads the id shape from that one group (zheref/nen#519), and the fixture pins the looseness. A body carries `## Acceptance criteria` or `## Requirements`, never both: the two are alternatives, `requirements` is optional on the `epic` kind only so that body-check shape-checks its rows, and a body carrying both is a body-check miss once nen refuses it (zheref/nen#553); at nen 0.28 the two are read as one union, an id repeated across them reported as a duplicate. At nen 0.28, `nen issue criteria` reads the Requirements section and `nen issue body-check` admits a withdrawn `AC-{n}` row in order; both Akatsuki forms are still unrecognised by `issue criteria` and `pr converge`, and body-check misreads an `AC-{epic}-{nnn}` row's id as `AC-{epic}`, until nen reads the id from this pattern (zheref/nen#519) and the annotation and withdrawn rows from this catalogue (zheref/nen#553).

reproduction.heading: Reproduction
reproduction.$comment: A defect's repro steps, expected against actual, platform and build, frequency (hatsu:file section 2).

failing-run.heading: Failing run
failing-run.$comment: A machinery defect's failing run link and what the guard should have done instead (hatsu:file section 2).

missing-rule.heading: Missing rule
missing-rule.$comment: A canon gap's missing or wrong rule and what a reader did instead because of it (hatsu:file section 2).

children.heading: Children
children.$comment: An epic's child issues or planned slices, one per line.

requirements.heading: Requirements
requirements.$comment: Akatsuki's acceptance section in its epic and child templates (zheref/akatsuki-ai schemas/templates/epic.md, child.md): the alternative to Acceptance criteria, never beside it. Optional on the epic kind so body-check reads its rows; no kind requires it, and no Hatsu template carries it.

entities.heading: Key entities
entities.$comment: Required only when the issue captures data; never required by a kind.

design-direction.heading: Design Direction
design-direction.$comment: Bisky's section for a brief naming a rendered surface (hatsu:emperor-time section 3).

plan-notes.heading: Plan notes
plan-notes.$comment: The only section where a flag, a verb or a path may appear.

success.shape: - SC-{n}: <a measurable outcome carrying a number or a percentage>
